speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have sudden onset abdominal pain; to help me narrow this down, can you tell me exactly where the pain is located and if it has moved? Have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, fever, or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Mesenteric Ischemia (likely due to acute limb ischemia or embolism related to recent MI). I will now request a CT angiography of the abdomen and pelvis to confirm the diagnosis and visualize bowel viability. REQUEST TEST: CT_Angiography_Abdomen_Pelvis. REQUEST IMAGES.
